name: M365Gov-InteractionContent-NativeOutcome
displayName: M365 Governance - Native Copilot Interaction Outcome with Content Context

authoritativeControlOwner.name: Microsoft Purview Audit and Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention
authoritativeControlOwner.sentinelRole: Surfaces Microsoft-provided CopilotInteraction outcomes and links them to collected interaction IDs; it never classifies prompt or response text.

dependencies.name: CopilotActivity
dependencies.owner: Microsoft Copilot data connector for Microsoft Sentinel

freshness.expected: CopilotActivity connector latency plus the collector's hourly schedule and ingestion lag.
freshness.evaluationWindow: Outcomes ingested in the last hour; content joined from the last two days.

limitations: Deployed only when interaction content collection is Enabled; installed disabled like every rule in this solution.
Alerts only on Microsoft-provided JailbreakDetected, XPIADetected, or Purview policy details in CopilotInteraction audit records.
Interaction content is linked by interaction ID for investigation and is never copied into alert fields.
ContentAvailable is false when the user is out of collection scope or the collector has not yet exported the interaction.

missingSourceBehavior.description: Without CopilotActivity the rule returns no results; use data health to confirm the connector before enabling.

incidentConfiguration.grouping: One alert per CopilotInteraction audit record.

severityRationale: Medium reflects a native Microsoft detection or policy outcome; the native product remains authoritative for severity.
falsePositiveGuidance: Validate the outcome in Microsoft Purview, then review the linked interaction content under your organization's approved investigation process.
testQuery: Run over an approved test window with a known CopilotInteraction audit record that carries a native outcome and confirm the interaction ID links to collected content.

privacy.promptOrResponseContent: Referenced by interaction ID only; content stays in the 90-day interaction table and is not written to alerts.
privacy.identityHandling: Actor name and ID come from the Purview audit record.
privacy.usageAsMisconduct: Prohibited without a separate approved investigation.
